_comment: Everything the client and patcher need to know about game memory. 'verified' stays false until every entry below has been confirmed on a real ROM (see docs/CALIBRATION.md). A null entry means 'not yet known' and disables the feature that needs it instead of guessing. Table shapes: {"address": "0x...", "kind": "bitfield|bytes|records|u8|u16|u32", "size": N}; 'bytes' tables may add "stride" (bytes per entry, the first is the count), 'records' tables need "record_size"; state flags may add "values": [..] listing the byte values that mean yes. optional_tables only back individual traps and may stay null in a verified map; a trap whose entries are null is dropped at generation. Calibrated on Medabots: Metabee Version (USA) in BizHawk 2.9.1; every address below was read back from the game's own code (Metabee USA ROM offsets given) and confirmed by making the game change it. RAM addresses are the same in all four versions (the code is the same apart from shifted data).

ap_block._comment: ROM region written by the patch with the seed/slot identity. The patcher refuses to write unless the whole region is still blank (0x00, which is how all four ROMs pad their unused space: 0x7F4488-0x7FFFFF is zero in every version).

game_flags._comment: The event flags. The game reaches them through the pointer at 0x030057D8 (always 0x030057E0). 4096 events, two per byte: event n lives in byte n >> 1, in the high nibble for even n and the low nibble for odd n. Bit 3 of the nibble (bit 7 / bit 3 of the byte) is the 'done' flag that script opcode 0x13 sets and 0x12 clears; bits 0-2 are a small per-event value (opcode 0x17). Event n is also the number of the event script of map object n, and most reward scripts set their own flag. Locations use {"type": "event", "flag": n} or {"type": "event_value", "flag": n, "value": v}. Confirmed: script 148 set 0x0300582A bit 7, script 1609 set 0x03005B04 bit 3.

parts_owned._comment: Two bytes per medapart, slot major: slot * 240 + model * 2. Byte 0 is how many the player owns (capped at 99 by the game), byte 1 how many of them are fitted. Confirmed: Guardian (model 39, head) arrived at 0x03004C8E, Ace Hooves (model 39, legs) at 0x03004F5E.

medals_owned._comment: The medal case: 30 records of 64 bytes. Byte 0 bit 7 = slot used, byte 1 = medal id, then level, experience, name (0x0A, 14 bytes, A=1..Z=26, padded with 0xFE) and stats. The client writes new records exactly like the game's routine at 0x08041D70 does, from the ROM medal table (rom_versions.json medal_table_offset). Confirmed byte for byte against records the game made for Tortoise and Bat.

money._comment: Read by 0x08047D4C, added to by 0x08047D58 (capped at 99999) and taken by 0x08047D74 (floored at 0). Script opcode 0x3A adds ten times its operand: chest script 1609 ('500') raised it from 0 to 5000.

safe_to_deliver._comment: The event-script engine's 'running' byte (script state base 0x030057E0 + 0xC88): 0 only while the player walks around freely; 1 during dialogue, cutscenes, shops, chests, scripted battles and the opening. The client additionally never delivers while in_battle is set, which covers random encounters. Not yet observed: the start menu (it could not be opened at the point of the game reached during calibration).

in_battle._comment: First byte of the game-mode block at 0x03000440: 1 from the 'get ready to Robattle' screen to the end of the battle, 0 in the field, in dialogue and in the opening.

hints._comment: Further addresses found during calibration that the client does not use (yet). Never read by the client.

party.note: 9 Medabots of 8 bytes: state (3 = complete), gender, medal slot, head/right arm/left arm/legs model ids, one more byte.

items.note: 64 entries of 2 bytes: 0x80 | item id, count. Script opcode 0x36 gives an item.

map.note: Current map id (one byte); 0x03005FDC/0x03005FDD hold the tile position a warp places the player on.

keys.note: Buttons held (u16, 1 = pressed); 0x0300058C holds the newly pressed ones.

script_engine.note: Script state block after the flags: +0xC88 running, +0xC89 waiting, +0xC8A offset, +0xC8E script number, +0xC2A battle id. The script bank pointer is at 0x03005590.

random_battle_id.note: Battle id chosen from the map's encounter table (0x083BF070 in Metabee USA) when no scripted battle is pending (0x0300640D == 0). A candidate for force_encounter, not yet tested.
